heading.title: Limitation for Taking Cognizance of Certain Offences

article.title: Continuing offence
article.content: In the case of a continuing offence, a fresh period of limitation shall begin to run at every moment of the time during which the offence continues.
article.html:
518Continuing offence

Section 518 · Chapter XXXVIII

In the case of a continuing offence, a fresh period of limitation shall begin to run at every moment of the time during which the offence continues.
